finance__procurement___index.md:295:1. Interview Candidate Reimbursement
support__on-call.md:347:## Mobile phone service and data reimbursement
finance__expenses.md:11:- Provide guidance around allowable reimbursable expenses.
finance__expenses.md:54:- Expenses for gifts and entertainment must be incurred and reimbursed in accordance with GitLab's [Gifts & Entertainment Policy](/handbook/legal/policies/gifts-contributions/#gifts-and-entertainment-policy) and [Antibribery Policy](/handbook/legal/anti-corruption-policy/).
finance__expenses.md:56:- Expense claims over 90 days from purchase date will not be reimbursed unless approved by the Manager.
finance__expenses.md:60:[Omitted long matching line]
finance__expenses.md:63:- Personal credits and gift cards: GitLab will reimburse only the actual out-of-pocket amount paid by the employee. If personal credits, gift cards, rewards points, or other discounts are applied to a business purchase, reimbursement will be limited to the net amount charged to the employee's personal payment method.
finance__expenses.md:64:Example: An employee purchases a $100 monitor and applies a $50 gift card. GitLab will reimburse $50 (the amount actually paid), not the pre-discount price of $100.
finance__expenses.md:67:- All work-related expenses (internet, co-working space, other monthly subscription, etc.) are not reimbursable while on Leave of any kind.
finance__expenses.md:68:[Omitted long matching line]
finance__expenses.md:75:- There will be occasions where if you have claimed an item and it needs to be reimbursed back to GitLab, you will need to follow the repayment process in Navan for submission of the funds.
finance__expenses.md:100:**Following expenses are categorized for reimbursement purposes with specific policy definition attached to it. The limits below are in USD, please use local currency equivalents when considering other currencies.**
finance__expenses.md:135:- Team Members may use personal frequent flyer miles or points for upgrades on business travel, however, Team Members will not be reimbursed for any respective charges.
finance__expenses.md:160:- Rental Cars are reimbursable and should be booked through Navan, up to the intermediate car class, with a 7 day booking lead time.
finance__expenses.md:185:In the event of an accident resulting in damage to the rental car, the Non-US rental agency will charge the credit card used to make the reservation with an estimated amount of repair costs if insurance is not purchased. If this happens, GitLab does not purchase Foreign Corporate Hired Auto Physical Damage Coverage to reimburse for damages.
finance__expenses.md:199:- Hotel stays are reimbursable up to $300 USD (or equivalent local currency) inclusive of tax per night for standard rooms, with a 7 day booking lead time.
finance__expenses.md:204:- Conference hotel room blocks or Corporate Events organized blocks will still need to be charged to a personal credit card and then submitted for reimbursement via Navan Expense.
finance__expenses.md:230:- Meals while traveling on Company business  are reimbursable, up to $120 USD (or local equivalent currency) per day.
finance__expenses.md:231:- Each Team Member must submit their own receipts for reimbursement, so ensure to separate billing when going to meals with groups of Team Members. If this is not practicable to do due to the group size, then the most senior Team Member present should pay the bill and submit for reimbursement.
finance__expenses.md:243:- Each Team Member must submit their own receipts for reimbursement, so ensure to separate billing when going to meals with groups of Team Members. If this is not practicable to do due to the group size, then the most senior Team Member present should pay the bill and submit for reimbursement.
finance__expenses.md:255:- Mileage is reimbursed according to local law, e.g.  US rate per mile, rate per km in the Netherlands, or rate in Belgium. Refer to "How Mileage Rates are Based" section below.
finance__expenses.md:275:- Yearly or Monthly Rail Discount cards are not reimbursable.
finance__expenses.md:305:- Internet while traveling is reimbursable for up to $50 USD (or local equivalent currency) per day.
finance__expenses.md:324:- If you are nursing while traveling on GitLab approved business, you can reimburse costs in order to travel with breast milk or ship your breast milk back home.
finance__expenses.md:330:- Check with your health plan to see if you are eligible for reimbursement for the cost of a breast pump or any other supplies.
finance__expenses.md:349:- Books are reimbursable if used to optimize your job position.
finance__expenses.md:369:- Coworking space is reimbursable for monthly space and one-off days during business travel. Pre-Approval is needed prior to submitting claims.
finance__expenses.md:373:- Coworking space is not reimbursable while on personal travel.
finance__expenses.md:379:- Travel to and from the co-working space, parking, meals, beverages, access cards, insurance and other additional expenses in a co-working facility are not reimbursable. Only the rent for the space is reimbursable.
finance__expenses.md:380:- If co-working space is used together with a combination of working from home, we will allow the reimbursement of the internet cost for where you spend most of your time. i.e. if you expense a co-working space for a full month then internet for home cannot be expensed. If you expense co-work for a few days in a month then home internet can be expensed in full.
finance__expenses.md:404:[Omitted long matching line]
finance__expenses.md:416:- As you onboard and start your GitLab journey, new hires will receive a 1,500 USD (or equivalent local currency) stipend to help you towards setting up your home office in your first year. Purchase the items you need using your own funds and submit a claim in Navan for reimbursement. Select the Expense Type: Work From Home – New Hire Stipend.
finance__expenses.md:422:- In addition the following items are not reimbursable: Phones, watches, smart speakers, smart TVs/smart monitors, walking pads/treadmills,tablets, book shelves, shelves, Cabinets, other furniture, wifi Mesh, Routers, Extenders/Boosters.
finance__expenses.md:428:- Purchase the items you need using your own funds and submit a claim in Navan for reimbursement. Select the Expense Type: Work From Home – New Hire Stipend.
finance__expenses.md:484:- Managers are able to send Gifts and Flowers on behalf of their team members in acknowledgment of significant life events such as well wishes ahead of surgery, or the loss of a loved one. Baby gifts are not reimbursable as GitLab already sends them a [gift](/handbook/people-group/celebrations/#new-parent-swag).
finance__expenses.md:491:- People Managers are to use their own personal card for expense reimbursement. People Managers will need to be sure to use Team `EmployeeGiftsFlowers` and the account 6028 in Navan Expense for the expense.
finance__expenses.md:502:- Monthly service charges for the internet are reimbursable, but GitLab will not reimburse for any initial setup, equipment, change fees, or monthly insurance charges.
finance__expenses.md:508:- Policy is set at $100 - claims above this amount will not be reimbursed. The limit has been reviewed and set to cover standard costs across all markets; individual exceptions are no longer assessed at the claim stage.
finance__expenses.md:510:- If an itemized bill is not available, costs will only be reimbursed for the element relating to Internet Access, i.e. if you pay for tv, internet and phone, the invoice should be divided by 3/# of services and we will pay this value only.
finance__expenses.md:512:- If co-working space is used together with a combination of working from home, we will allow the reimbursement of the internet cost for where you spend most of your time. i.e. if you expense a co-working space for a full month then internet for home cannot be expensed. If you expense co-work for a few days in a month then home internet can be expensed in full.
finance__expenses.md:541:- Small purchases for marketing events which are under $5,000 USD and which cannot be paid through the Procurement Process (Zip) are reimbursable.
finance__expenses.md:555:- Meals are otherwise reimbursable, however Team Members should be mindful of budget while claiming meals with clients and partners.
finance__expenses.md:559:- The bill should be paid by the most senior Team Member present and submitted for reimbursement by that Team Member.
finance__expenses.md:589:- Monthly service charges for cell phones are reimbursable for Team Members whose phones are vital to their position.
finance__expenses.md:590:- Policy is set at $100 - claims above this amount will not be reimbursed. The limit has been reviewed and set to cover standard costs across all markets; individual exceptions are no longer assessed at the claim stage.
finance__expenses.md:593:- If itemized bill is not available, then the costs will only be reimbursed for the element relating to Phone Service, i.e. if you pay for tv, internet and phone, the invoice should be divided by 3/# of services and we will pay this value only.
finance__expenses.md:594:- Only the employee's portion of a family plan is reimbursable.
finance__expenses.md:595:- Actual cell phone, phone accessories, and monthly hardware costs are not reimbursable.
finance__expenses.md:596:- In addition Tablets, Watches, Phone Devices are not reimbursable.
finance__expenses.md:604:- Postage/shipping/custom charges related to the sending and or receiving of work documentation or special packages can be reimbursed.
finance__expenses.md:614:- Other costs associated with professional dues and membership fees are reimbursable and an approved G&D request in Compass (for requests opened before June 23, 2026, the approved G&D GitLab issue) will need to be noted in the expense report upon submission.
finance__expenses.md:624:- No software subscriptions are reimbursable.
finance__expenses.md:653:- All costs associated with training or tuition are reimbursable.
finance__expenses.md:668:1. Starting July 15, 2026, GitLab no longer reimburses personal VPN subscriptions (such as ExpressVPN, Proton, Mullvad, and similar services) through expense claims.
finance__expenses.md:690:### 4.4 Reimbursement Payout Timelines
finance__expenses.md:692:The procedure by which reimbursable expenses are processed varies and is dependent on contributor legal status (e.g. independent contractor, Team Member) and subsidiary assignment.
finance__expenses.md:697:- Expenses for GitLab Inc, GitLab Federal, GitLab Ltd (UK), GitLab BV (Belgium and Netherlands), GitLab GmbH (Germany), GitLab PTY Ltd (Australia and New Zealand), GitLab GK (Japan) GitLab LTD (Ireland), GitLab Israel Ltd., GitLab Korea Limited, GitLab Canada Corp and GitLab Singapore PTE. LTD. are reimbursed via Navan within 7 business days for the expenses within policy or after approval by the Accounts Payable team (for out of policy expenses).
finance__expenses.md:700:- Navan will be implementing a Batched Payment system for team members who are reimbursed directly through Navan. If you submit multiple expenses during the week, Navan will batch these expenses into one single weekly payment that will be paid out on Mondays. These payments will include all approved expenses up until the Sunday evening prior, and should hit the team member’s bank accounts on Tuesday or Wednesday.
finance__expenses.md:728:[Omitted long matching line]
finance__expenses.md:763:- Team members can view if their reimbursements have been processed successfully or failed on both mobile and desktop versions. If the reimbursement fails, the team member will receive a notification and how to fix it in Navan.
finance__expenses.md:814:### Expense Reimbursement for Terminated Team Members
finance__expenses.md:816:[Omitted long matching line]
